entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 90.7 +/- 4.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V916 Aql: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 90.7 +/- 4.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 63,099,990 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 250 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 308, Name='V916 Aql', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 250 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
